visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with her hair tied up in a bun, wearing a black t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit indoor bathroom holding a translucent pink bottle of AHA cleansing oil. She points enthusiastically at the bottle while smiling and speaking directly to the camera. (2) Close-up shots show the viscous, clear cleansing oil being pumped into her open palm and then onto her forearm, which has several cosmetic makeup swatches. The gel-like oil spreads across the skin in a white porcelain sink environment under bright lighting. (3) The woman massages the oil onto her face while looking into a bathroom mirror, her hands moving in circular motions. Graphic overlays appear, displaying the product's packaging and technical text about ingredients like 4HA. (4) Extreme close-ups highlight the smooth texture of the oil on her skin, followed by a sequence of her rinsing her face with running water at the tap and patting her face dry to reveal clean, glowing skin. (5) In the final segment, the woman displays her refreshed face with a satisfied expression and points to the side. The product is then shown in a lifestyle setting on a green cushion, followed by credit screens with QR codes and social media logos.
